The DNA Exchange, 'ACMG Carrier Screening Guideline: The Hypothetical Tier 3 Panel' (2022) - reproduction of the 113-gene Tier 3 table used for the gene list
Thai exome study of the 113 ACMG genes (Supplementary S3 Table genes all fall within the list)
Arjunan A et al. Evaluation and classification of severity for 176 genes on an expanded carrier screening panel. Prenat Diagn 2020;40:1246-1257
Jain R et al. Pathogenic variation underlying rare diseases in an Arab population. Genet Med Open 2025 (Emirati exome carrier rates, MOHAP 570-gene list)
Alblooshi K et al. Citywide premarital genomic screening in a Middle Eastern population. Nat Med 2026 (1,000 Dubai couples, 782 genes)
Burden of heterozygote carriers for autosomal recessive conditions in the Middle East: a study of 14,392 genomes. HGG Adv 2026
Emirati Genome Programme carrier preprint (medRxiv; abstract only accessible)
Arab Variant Database (AVDB) preprint (bioRxiv; aggregate at-risk couple rates only, no per-gene figures)

Shafique et al. UAE newborn screening 2021-2023. Front Pediatr 2026

notes: Gene list: the 113 ACMG 2021 Tier 3 genes (97 autosomal recessive + 16 X-linked) were taken from a public reproduction of the ACMG table (thednaexchange.com) because the ACMG paper's full text was behind a bot check; the split of 97 AR + 16 X-linked matches the paper's stated counts, and every gene with variants in a Thai study of the same 113 genes falls within the list. Symbols are current HGNC symbols; acmg_symbol keeps the symbol used by ACMG where it changed (GBA->GBA1, G6PC->G6PC1). Severity comes only from Arjunan et al. 2020 (medical-geneticist final call); genes that paper did not classify have no severity field. The ACMG paper's own per-condition severity table could not be accessed. literature_carrier_freq prefers Emirati data. Most Emirati values are from 1,194 exomes of individuals referred for clinical testing (sequence variants only), so they can be biased and they miss deletions, repeats and pseudogene events (see cnv_heavy). SMN1 and HBA1/HBA2 use dedicated Emirati studies instead. literature_carrier_freq_other lists further Gulf estimates (Qatari genomes, Saudi/Kuwaiti/Omani screening programmes). Values are copied as published, with the measure stated; trait prevalence and allele frequency are not the same as carrier frequency. uae_premarital flags membership of the MOHAP 570-gene premarital list (reproduced in Jain 2025 Suppl. Table 6) and the Dubai 782-gene panel (Alblooshi 2026 Suppl. Table 2). treatable, condition names, mild_alleles and cnv notes are short editorial summaries for a demo, not clinical guidance; the per-gene GeneReviews search link is given for checking. condition_ar is included only where an Arabic name was found on a named source (condition_ar_source).
